headline: Nas 倫敦演出走懷舊路線
context: 紐約饒舌傳奇 Nas 在倫敦水晶宮碗形劇場登台，與 The Roots 同場演出——這是美國老牌音樂節 Roots Picnic 第一次移師倫敦。樂評形容他重現九零年代的經典，狀態懷舊。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Crystal Palace Bowl, London Nas performs his gritty but intricate 90s classics, sharing the bill on the first London edition of the Roots Picnic festival with Questlove and co’s exuberant funk Looking out over the audience at the Crystal Palace Bowl, Nas feels moved to reminisce about his first visit to London. It was in 1994, around the time he released his landmark debut album Illmatic ; he remembers performing on pirate radio stations and “eating good Jamaican food”. It seems unlikely that he ever thought he’d be back in the capital sharing the stage with a man playing a sousaphone, but such is the power of the Roots Picnic, a US institution for nearly 20 years. Its famously eclectic bill has regularly featured great rappers backed by hip-hop’s premier live band, sousaphone player and all: Lil’ Wayne, the Wu-Tang Clan, Snoop Dogg, Jay-Z. Before Nas appears at the festival’s first London iteration, the Roots play their own set, augmented by a guest appearance from Common. It plays out almost as one long medley which shifts restlessly between their own back catalogue and old funk, soul and disco covers. They do a killer version of James Brown’s The Payback. Awesomely tight, driven by the relentless crack of drummer Questlove’s snare and heavy on jazzy brass solos, it’s a perfect demonstration of the unique musical space they’ve carved out over the years, somewhere between hip-hop and jam band: the Grateful Dead of rap, if you like. thread_text:
紐約饒舌傳奇 Nas 在倫敦水晶宮碗形劇場（Crystal Palace Bowl）登台，與 The Roots 同場——這是美國辦了近二十年的音樂節 Roots Picnic 第一次移師倫敦。樂評形容 Nas 這場走懷舊路線，演出九零年代的經典作品，還聊起 1994 年第一次來倫敦的往事——那正是他發行經典專輯 Illmatic 的年代。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日發佈的樂評。
threads_text:
紐約饒舌傳奇 Nas 在倫敦開唱了。場地在水晶宮碗形劇場（Crystal Palace Bowl），同場的是 The Roots——美國辦了近二十年的音樂節 Roots Picnic，這是第一次移師倫敦。樂評形容 Nas 這場走的是懷舊路線：演出九零年代那些粗礪又精緻的經典，還在台上聊起 1994 年第一次來倫敦的回憶，那正是他發行經典專輯 Illmatic 的年代。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日發佈的樂評，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
voice_text: 紐約饒舌傳奇 Nas，在倫敦跟 The Roots 同台了。場地在水晶宮的碗形劇場——美國辦了快二十年的音樂節 Roots Picnic，第一次移師倫敦。有樂評形容，Nas 這場走懷舊路線，演的是九零年代的經典，他還在台上聊起一九九四年第一次來倫敦的往事——那正是他發行經典專輯 Illmatic 的年代。這是一篇評論，觀點聽聽就好。
